review_candidates.title: Vice President of Business Continuity
review_candidates.description: Company Description MBS Foundation is a purpose-driven organization focused on maternal and child healthcare, quality medical services, and community development. Key goals include building a 100-bed Mother and Child Center, providing subsidized quality healthcare for pediatric patients, and supporting antenatal care. The foundation works to empower underserved communities through sustainable solutions, awareness programs, and strategic partnerships. Guided by compassion and innovation, MBS Foundation is committed to creating a healthier, more equitable society where every individual can thrive. Its ethos, “Empowering Communities, Transforming Lives,” reflects a strong commitment to meaningful and lasting impact. Role Description The Vice President of Business Continuity is a full-time remote role responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing comprehensive business continuity and resilience strategies across the foundation’s healthcare and community programs. This role involves assessing operational risks, developing continuity plans for critical services, and ensuring that emergency response and recovery procedures are in place and regularly tested. The Vice President will collaborate with leadership, finance, project teams, and external partners to align continuity plans with organizational goals, including the development and operation of the Mother and Child Center. Day-to-day tasks include leading risk and impact analyses, setting continuity standards, monitoring compliance, preparing regular reports for senior leadership, and guiding staff training and awareness initiatives. The role also requires ongoing evaluation and improvement of continuity frameworks to support sustainable growth and reliable service delivery in underserved communities. Qualifications Strong Analytical Skills and Business Analysis capabilities to identify risks, evaluate impacts, and design effective continuity strategies. Finance and budgeting skills to align continuity initiatives with financial plans and ensure cost-effective risk mitigation. Project Management experience to lead cross-functional continuity projects, coordinate stakeholders, and deliver initiatives on time. Sales and stakeholder engagement skills to advocate for continuity priorities, secure buy-in, and build strategic partnerships. Proven leadership experience in business continuity, risk management, or operations within healthcare, nonprofit, or related sectors. Excellent communication, negotiation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote, distributed environment. Experience developing and implementing crisis management, disaster recovery, or resilience frameworks is highly beneficial. Relevant academic background such as a degree in Business, Finance, Management, Public Health, or a related field; advanced certifications in business continuity or risk management are an advantage.

Sendcloud powers 30,000+ online retailers, marketplaces, and fulfillment companies. Helping them ship smarter, grow faster, and actually get shit done for their customers. Boring logistics? Not here. We're building the platform that solves shipping, at scale, globally! As we scale past 30,000+ retailers, the complexity at our data layer is growing just as fast — query bottlenecks, oversized instances, and PostgreSQL knowledge gaps across teams. You'd join our Platform Engineering domain to own that complexity end to end, from query performance and schema design to backup strategy and disaster recovery. Own our backup and disaster-recovery strategy end to end, including restore testing and clear RTO/RPO targets. Shape our long-term PostgreSQL strategy — tooling, observability, and cost-efficiency — as we continue to scale. 🎯 What you'll do Operate and improve PostgreSQL clusters running on AWS RDS and Aurora, tuning performance and resolving bottlenecks before they become incidents.
